narr: Numerous showers and storms developed ahead of an approaching cold front on June 26, 2024. Some of these storms became severe, producing sporadic wind damage and a few severe hail reports across central Pennsylvania. There was also some flash flooding reported across the northwest mountains in portions of Warren and McKean counties.
ev: Locally heavy rain associated with thunderstorms produced radar estimated 3-4 inches of rain, causing flash flooding with water running across the roadway at the intersection of South Carver Street and Lexington Avenue on the southeast side of Warren.
